precepts.why:

And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.”

Sword, hunger, death, and the beasts of the earth are the same instruments of judgment the Most High named in Leviticus.

I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals: this is the precept for the Lamb, because people get dumb as hell; Christians make me sick, these damn Christian commentaries are dumb as hell. What is the Lamb? “And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!” That is what we wanted. So in Revelation 6:1 the Lamb is talking about Christ.

White generally symbolizes righteousness, so many Christian commentaries say the white horse might be Christ. This is not talking about Christ, because Christ is the one that opened the first seal. This is going into a man that would portray himself as righteous, conquering. “And it was given unto him” We want to know about this him. “to make war with the saints,” The saints are the children of Israel (Psalms 148:14): to make war with the Israelites. “and to overcome them:” To overcome, or to conquer them. “and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Not only did he overcome and conquer the Israelites, he had power over all kindreds, tongues and nations.

Who are the saints? You are going to find out the Bible is redundant; Revelation is very redundant. The same thing the New Testament says is always said in the Old Testament as well. “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel,” So the children of Israel are the saints. So in Revelation 13:7, to make war with the saints is to make war with the Israelites.

Write this down: the white horse goes back to Zechariah 6:3. “And in the third chariot white horses;” So this white horse goes back to the same white horse of Zechariah 6:3, wherein this man would go forth and conquer.

Why does it say white? Christ warned us about something. Remember what Zechariah said: they went forth into the land of the north. “And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” The Spanish conquest: the new world was named America after Amerigo Vespucci, another explorer who traveled along the coast of South America, the south country, because when they started they went through the south country first, conquering the Incas, followed by the Mayans and the Aztecs, working their way up to the north country. Thousands of Spaniards sailed to the Americas hoping to get what they wanted, some to become rich, others to spread their religion. See them down there praying: they all came allegedly in the name of white man Jesus. That is what they did; they came in the name of Jesus, conquering. Conquistadors like Hernan Cortes and Francisco Pizarro didn't want to explore; they wanted to conquer the land and own it, money and gold for themselves and their king, and they fought until they won. Montezuma believed the Spaniards were gods; a war began, many Aztecs died from smallpox, a disease the conquistadors introduced, and even though Cortes only had 600 soldiers he defeated the Aztecs and began a new government in the name of Spain. A hundred years after the conquest the Aztec population had decreased from 25 million to one million. Damn.

This white horse had a crown, had a bow, and went forth conquering and to conquer, and the prophet Habakkuk spoke about this very same thing. “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans,” The Chaldeans are the upper echelon, the elite of the ancient Cushites, but this goes beyond the Cushites: this is a metaphor, a similitude for the so-called white man, Esau, like Deuteronomy 28:46 says, the curses are a sign and a wonder upon our seed for ever, and God's words are double in meaning (Job 11:6). “that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land,” From south towards the north. “to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.” Didn't the conquistadors do that? You better believe they did this thing. That is why Esau is called the daughter of Babylon.

“They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.” That goes with another scripture, the pride of their heart has deceived them. “Their horses also are swifter than the leopards,” Yes, they came with horses. “and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far;” Meaning Spain. “they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.” It is letting you know their symbol: the symbol of Spain was the eagle.

“They shall come all for violence:” They didn't come for spices; God says they came for violence, to conquer the twelve tribes of Israel. That was their mission, that was their goal, and they were very successful. “their faces shall sup up as the east wind,” Because they came from the east. “and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.” That is the proof: they gathered the captivity.

“And they shall scoff at the kings,” They scoffed at all the kings they found and came across; they didn't give a damn about Montezuma, Atahualpa. “and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold;” Whatever stronghold we had, among the Incas and the Mayans that had many strongholds, they tore into them things. Esau came with armor and they thought these dudes were invincible, until one of them, in Puerto Rico, said let's drown one of them and see if he is a god. They held him underwater with all his armor on till the last bubble came up: he's not a god, they're not gods. They went crazy going after Esau, but even then Satan was rolling with Esau; Satan said don't worry, I got this. “for they shall heap dust, and take it.”

“Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.” Who was the god he came with? Cesare Borgia as Jesus Christ. Look at the face: they are already doing the sign of the cross. They gave credit to their god; this is not the God of our people. The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; he shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him (Deuteronomy 28:43-44): he came into our house and got above us in our house, and in our house he lends to us with our own resources, our wood, our water, our bauxite, our gold, our diamonds. The Clintons did the same to Haiti with the rice: bread, oil, rice are the everyday things, and destroying them makes a country fall into deep poverty, so now you have to buy from them. In Sierra Leone the illiteracy rate was something like 60%: when you are poor your kids can't go to school, because you have to pay, and they have to go out and work to bring a little money to the house.

And if a nation doesn't want to play ball? See thou hurt not the oil and the wine. The economic hit man said it himself: if we don't like what a democratically elected leader of another country is doing, for example opposing the exploitation of oil in his country, someone who looks like me walks into that president's office and says, I can make you and your family very, very rich if you play our game, or I can see to it that you are thrown out of office or assassinated if you decide to fulfill your campaign promises. These are the ones that were murdered and killed, or died following the Bible, following the scriptures. Your mama followed Cesare Borgia; God doesn't want to hear nothing she has to say. So don't make excuses for your grandma: she always read the Bible, but she was worshipping the devil, so God ain't listening to her. When you die in this truth, all praises, you are going to talk to the Lord.

The souls of the righteous ask God when he is going to avenge them, and Christ said the same thing: he gave a parable and taught us to pray for vengeance (Luke 18:1-8). Shall not God avenge his own elect, the Israelites, which cry day and night unto him? I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth? He asked that because some of you don't believe it; you think it is evil to pray for vengeance, because we have white supremacy in our mind. “And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season,” We are in that little season right now; this is the time we are in. We are in the fifth seal. “until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.” So some of our people are going to be killed as they were; the brothers that stand up for righteousness will be killed.

“And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal,” The sixth seal has not come yet; as we read down you will see what the sixth seal is. “And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth,” That is talking about their satellites. Pay attention to verse 13. “even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.” Isaiah 34:4 says the same: all their host shall fall down, their satellites, their jets, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

“And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together;” This is destruction, World War III. The heaven departed as a scroll: that is that mushroom cloud. The heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll, and my sword shall come down upon Idumea, the Greco-Roman word for Edom, and upon the people of my curse (Isaiah 34:4-5). This whole thing is about the destruction of Idumea: that goes with the white horse, the red horse, the black horse, the pale horse, then comes destruction. “and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.” You all living on them islands: God doesn't care if you are in Jamaica, the Bahamas, Puerto Rico, Santo Domingo, Haiti. The 911 is over; there is no gin or vodka falling from the sky, it's wormwood; their welfare system is over. Everything they allowed the black woman to have a big mouth about, that day is going to be over. That day when they come out of the bunker they are going to see the pure black man: oh, what happened to black people, why didn't they get burnt? No, they're coming for you; knock on the mountain door. Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: don't rely on the white man to save you; he can die just like you; he will be dead along with you for relying on him (Isaiah 2:19-22). John got this from Isaiah; everything John saw in Revelation you read in Isaiah, and it is a wonder Isaiah didn't lose his mind.

“And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?” So let the congregation say amen.

“I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held”: there are Israelites who have already been sealed from way back. The apostles and those loyal men that followed them were sealed, and some of the prophets; these are the souls you are reading about here.

“How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?”: this shows you that the souls of the righteous speak to the Lord. The Lord don’t want to hear the wicked. It is only the righteous he gives ear to, those that gave their lives for this truth.

“That they should rest yet for a little season”: this little season is the season we are living in right now. We are in the fifth seal. “Until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled”: that does not mean everybody that follows the law is going to be put to death.
